technical_approach.narrative: Three-phase sequence: Office wing Days 1-25 (5,100 sq ft, complete isolation from main roof); Main roof NW quadrant Days 26-55 (20,000 sq ft, coordinated with warehouse ops); Main roof SE quadrant including ponding areas Days 56-85 (25,000 sq ft with tapered insulation). Max 8,000 sq ft exposed at any time (below RFP 15,000 cap); each phase watertight daily by 5:00 PM; weekend reinforced tarps with weighted edges; wireless temperature monitoring with +-2C alerts; HVAC coordination with 72-hr notice and weekend shutdowns.
technical_approach.tear_off_staging_plan: Phased tear-off with complete isolation between office wing and main roof; max 8,000 sq ft exposed at any time; dumpster placement coordinated with warehouse operations schedule.
technical_approach.weather_protection_plan: Each phase watertight daily by 5:00 PM; weekend protection with reinforced tarps and weighted edges; specific temperature monitoring protocol with wireless sensors and +-2C deviation alerts. Dry-in procedure implied per phase; specific forecast-monitoring protocol not explicitly named.
technical_approach.fall_protection_plan: COR certified; annually updated fall protection training for all workers; dedicated safety officer on-site (Patricia Lee, CRSP); daily tailgate safety meetings; zero lost-time incidents in past 7 yrs; WSIB Experience Rating 0.72. No site-specific anchor-point layout or named fall-arrest equipment inventory.
technical_approach.waste_disposal_plan: Roof removal with disposal included ($105,000 line item includes hazardous material testing). Pre-removal testing at 12 locations for asbestos and lead. Minor ACM handled under existing abatement license; lead flashings handled as hazardous waste. No named disposal facility or diversion rate. No DSA plan per O. Reg. 278/05 explicitly stated.

wsib_clearance.evidence: Insurance Coverage: 'Workers Compensation: WSIB Account #9876543-21'. Attachments list includes 'WSIB Clearance Certificate' and 'WSIB Experience Rating Letter (0.72)'. Experience rating 0.72 (below 1.0) is a strong favorable signal.
wsib_clearance.notes: Certificate attached; experience-rating letter corroborates active good-standing status. Standard award condition to re-verify at clearances.wsib.ca is automatically added by recommendation memo skill.

cgl_insurance.notes: Limit handily passes; three sub-criteria (AI endorsement, completed-ops years, named-insured identity) must be read from the attached COI before compliance is confirmed (fixture 04 section 2, section 5).

working_at_heights.evidence: Safety Program: 'Fall protection training for all workers (updated annually)'; COR (Certificate of Recognition) certified; dedicated safety officer (Patricia Lee, CRSP); zero lost-time incidents in past 7 years.
working_at_heights.notes: Annual refresher exceeds the regulatory 3-year validity floor of O. Reg. 297/13; COR certification is a stronger signal than most bidders provide. Owner may still request CPO-approved provider name, worker certificate numbers, and expiry dates as award condition.

minimum_similar_projects.evidence: Four references provided, all commercial/institutional occupied facilities with similar or larger scope: Maple Leaf Food (125k sqft, 2023), Shoppers Drug Mart DC (210k sqft, 2022), Magnotta Winery (68k sqft, 2024), Pfizer Canada (95k sqft, 2025). red_flags.description: Claimed '30-year NDL on TPO membrane' but RFP requires total_system_ndl and bid does not name the specific manufacturer, system, or warranty program. Contractor holds Carlisle Master Installer, Firestone Premier Contractor, and GAF Master Elite certifications — strong credentials, but GAF Master Elite is primarily the residential tier (the matching commercial top-tiers are Carlisle Authorized Applicator for 30-yr Golden Seal, Firestone Platinum Master Contractor for Red Shield Platinum, or Sika Authorized Applicator). Without a named manufacturer system, the owner cannot confirm the warranty program, required pre-install drawing review, or mid-job manufacturer inspection (all prerequisites for a true total-system NDL per fixture 02 section 3).
red_flags.citation: fixture 02 section 1.3 (Carlisle Golden Seal tiers), section 3.1-3.7 (certified-contractor programs and prerequisites), section 4 red-flag #5; RFP section 3.1, section 9.6.
red_flags.evidence: Cover Letter Warranty: '30-year NDL (No Dollar Limit) warranty on TPO membrane'; Manufacturer Certifications section lists three manufacturers without committing which supplies the proposed assembly. technical_approach.notes: Tear-off/staging detailed with 8k sqft max exposure, 3-phase sequencing, adjacent-property protection, dumpster placement = 25. Weather protection specific dry-in plan per phase with daily 5:00 PM close-out + weighted-edge weekend tarps + wireless temperature monitoring with +-2C alerts = 20 (no explicit forecast-monitoring protocol keeps it below 25 max). Fall protection generic-plus (COR certified, dedicated CRSP officer, zero LTI 7 yrs) but no site-specific anchor-point layout or rescue plan = 10. Waste/environmental: disposal + hazmat testing included, no DSA plan explicitly per O. Reg. 278/05 = 8. Quality control: final roof inspection with manufacturer representative + weekly progress reports + temperature monitoring protocol attached = 15.

experience_references.notes: Four comparable references (3-4 band) = 40. Most recent 2025 (Pfizer) = 25 (<1 yr). All four include named contact, phone, role, completion year, sqft, and scope description — complete on every reference except dollar value = 15. If project value were stated this would be a perfect 100.

Triple manufacturer certification (Carlisle Master Installer, Firestone Premier Contractor, GAF Master Elite) at claimed warranty tier = 20. 5-yr workmanship = 10 (top bracket). 80 mil + HD polyiso cover board + fully adhered = exceeds industry standard = 10.

schedule.notes: Timeline detailed with phase sequencing + milestones (Phase 1-2-3 day counts, named tapered-insulation phase) = 40. Crew adequacy: named foreman (Frank Kowalski 22yr) + PM (Carlos Mendez PMP) + dedicated CRSP safety officer + 4 lead installers + phasing coordinator = 20 (adequate + named foreman; would be 25 if multiple crews/surge capacity explicitly stated). Mobilization (May 1) and substantial completion (Jul 25) both align with RFP window = 20. Occupied-building accommodation: named tenant coordination, HVAC 72-hr notice protocol, weekend-only shutdowns, wireless temperature monitoring = 15.

OWNER FOLLOW-UP: Four references provided but no project VALUE on any of them. Comparable-reference test cannot fully verify the 0.5x-2x project-value band (qualification SKILL section 8). Scope/size/recency are exceptionally strong (Pfizer Canada pharmaceutical, Shoppers Drug Mart DC, Maple Leaf Food) — value-data gap is a documentation issue, not a substantive one.
OWNER FOLLOW-UP: Wind uplift design basis (CSA A123.21 / FM 1-29) not stated. Wind warranty of 130 mph cited but no calculated uplift pressures per zone and fastening schedule.

Hazardous Materials approach provides pre-removal testing (12 locations) but does not reference the owner's Designated Substances Report / DSA for the 1998 building. Major abatement excluded — consistent with RFP section 2.3 which pushes actual abatement cost to the owner.

80 mil membrane and R-38 insulation are BOTH above the RFP baseline (60 mil / R-30). Scoped as upgrades rather than substitutions of equal value — owner can either accept the upgrades or request a deduct-to-baseline for comparability.

Optional extended workmanship warranty to 10 years available at $12,000 alternate. Base workmanship warranty of 5 years is already well above the RFP section 9.6 2-year minimum and matches the Ontario market median.
